detail.longDescription: Jesse Walker spent years as a tech product manager. About 10 years ago he left the industry to turn his evening gig, coaching jiu-jitsu, into a full-time one. He now owns and coaches at Rough Hands BJJ in Louisville, Kentucky. Rough Hands BJJ has been open for 10 years and teaches Brazilian jiu-jitsu to about 200 students in the Louisville area. The product brain came with him. "I have lots of techie stuff kind of infused in my business," he says. He even worked with Claude to build an Apple TV
